settings.layer1_body:
Radiant Life™ is not a medical service.

The Assessment and RL100 Documentation System do not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. They document participant-provided and system-structured observational inputs under fixed exposure conditions over time.

All information provided is descriptive and educational in nature, intended to support structured self-understanding — not medical decision-making.

No individual outcome is predicted or implied.

Participants should consult qualified healthcare professionals for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

settings.title: Measurement vs Diagnosis
settings.body: Measurement observes change. Diagnosis assigns meaning and treatment. Radiant Life™ operates strictly in the former. Radiant Life™ does not assign clinical meaning to documented changes.

settings.title: Why Outcomes Are Not Predicted
settings.body: Biological response varies across individuals and contexts. Prediction introduces expectation bias and degrades interpretability. The system documents outcomes after completion — it does not forecast them.
